accepted_upstream_properties: The curriculum targets dynamic episode-local semantic-to-symbol routing rather than reteaching already-strong semantic readout or carrier algebra.
The 4-template x 6-S3 x 3-class seed gives a clean 72-row minimum causal design before lexical-family replication.
The realized S3 mapping, not the logged permutation id, is required to construct the target.
Codebook display order is explicitly separated from semantic-to-symbol mapping.
T5 unseen-template, unseen-symbol and retention holdouts are intended to be frozen before tuning.
Synthetic/source-design rows remain non-promoting and mint zero accepted-dataset/model/J-Space/training/HCU/product credit.

residual_risks.finding: S3 slot balance over ATOM_A/B/C does not by itself prove balance over the actual 46 accepted tokenizer atoms if triplets are redrawn across rows or families.
residual_risks.failure_mode: A real token identity can become correlated with hidden class, target status, template, codebook position or split even while slot-level S3 counts are perfect.
residual_risks.required_fix: Materialize atom assignments in deterministic counterbalanced blocks and validate empirical independence using actual atom identities/token ids, not placeholders. At minimum report class<->target_atom, template<->target_atom, codebook_position<->atom and split<->atom contingency tables plus mutual information; fail closed on non-preregistered imbalance.

residual_risks.finding: The design correctly requires paired causal counterfactuals, but their materialized split identity must be atomic at the full counterfactual-family/provenance ancestry level.
residual_risks.failure_mode: If one member of a CODEBOOK_FLIP/SEMANTIC_FLIP/ORDER_SHUFFLE family reaches train while its near-duplicate counterpart reaches validation or holdout, the benchmark can leak despite lexical disjointness checks.
residual_risks.required_fix: Assign one immutable causal_family_id/provenance_ancestry_id before split and force every derived counterfactual/paraphrase/order variant of that base episode into the same split.

residual_risks.finding: An unseen-symbol holdout is only valid if reserved atom identities are absent from all model-visible training codebooks, not merely absent as training targets.
residual_risks.failure_mode: A holdout atom shown repeatedly as a non-target codebook entry is not symbol-unseen even if it never appears as the correct training answer.
residual_risks.required_fix: Freeze a reserved atom pool before materialization and reject every train/validation row containing a reserved holdout atom anywhere in model-visible text or serialized codebook fields.

residual_risks.finding: ALLOW/DENY/ABSTAIN inside the codebook is a valid preregistered resolution for the current source tension, but it tests binding with stable semantic class names.
residual_risks.failure_mode: A model may improve on the labelled family without learning a more general episode-local variable-binding operation needed outside those exact labels.
residual_risks.required_fix: Keep the labelled 72-row seed as the first controlled family, then add a separately versioned label-free/episodic-alias family only after the labelled seed passes. Do not mix the two before the first baseline is frozen.

adversarial_training_pair_expansion.construction: Keep semantic case, template, S3 relation and display order fixed; consistently substitute the three real ABI atoms with a disjoint accepted triplet. The target must follow the rematerialized mapping.

adversarial_training_pair_expansion.purpose: Force the same actual atom identity to serve different semantic classes across episodes.
adversarial_training_pair_expansion.construction: Across a preregistered block, rotate each training atom through ALLOW, DENY and ABSTAIN target roles as evenly as the finite design permits while preserving exact causal mapping.
Balance each training atom's appearances as target and as non-target codebook entry; do not let a subset become target-heavy.

adversarial_training_pair_expansion.purpose: Separate atom identity from codebook position.
adversarial_training_pair_expansion.construction: Keep realized semantic-to-atom mapping fixed while independently permuting codebook display order; target remains invariant.
All codebook-flip, semantic-flip, display-order, lexical-paraphrase and distractor variants derived from one base episode share one immutable family/provenance split assignment.
Reserved holdout atoms are never present anywhere in model-visible train or validation codebooks; they first appear in frozen holdout episodes.

adversarial_training_pair_expansion.purpose: Test whether the learned operation generalizes beyond fixed ALLOW/DENY/ABSTAIN names.
adversarial_training_pair_expansion.construction: After the labelled seed is frozen/evaluated, define episode-local aliases or demonstrations that establish three roles without canonical class words, then remap those roles to accepted atoms. Keep this as a separately versioned family.

validator_delta: ACTUAL_ATOM_IDENTITY_TABLES: compute class/target/template/position/split x actual atom identity counts.
ACTUAL_ATOM_MI: compute empirical mutual information using actual atom ids; slot-only ATOM_A/B/C statistics are insufficient.
TARGET_NONTARGET_EXPOSURE_BALANCE: reject systematic atom target-frequency skew outside preregistered finite-design tolerance.
COUNTERFACTUAL_FAMILY_SPLIT_LOCK: all descendants of one causal base episode must share split.
HOLDOUT_ATOM_GLOBAL_ABSENCE: reserved unseen atoms must be absent from every model-visible train/validation codebook position.
ALIAS_FAMILY_VERSION_SEPARATION: labelled and label-free binding families cannot silently share a benchmark version or holdout.

research_return.new_training_rule: Counterbalancing must be performed over realized token identities as well as abstract S3 slots; an abstractly balanced codebook can still leak through the concrete vocabulary.
research_return.new_harness_rule: The future harness must trace actual atom/token identity, target/non-target exposure and causal-family split identity in addition to realized mapping and display order.
research_return.new_falsifier: If performance collapses when actual atom identities and labelled class names are held out despite success on slot-balanced labelled episodes, the model likely learned a narrower lexical remapping shortcut rather than a robust variable-binding operation.
research_return.anti_goodhart: Aggregate remapping accuracy cannot compensate for leakage through atom frequency, position, family crossover or prior exposure of supposedly unseen symbols.

next_exact_actions: Obtain/bind the exact 46 accepted ABI atom identities and tokenizer ids at the existing source-package/manifest identity.
Materialize the 72-row labelled seed only with deterministic actual-atom counterbalancing and atomic counterfactual-family split assignment.
Run slot-level S3, actual-atom exposure/MI, leakage, provenance, unseen-symbol-global-absence and family-split validators before lexical-family scaling.
After the labelled seed is frozen and evaluated, add the separately versioned label-free alias family as a generalization discriminator rather than silently mixing it into the first baseline.
